Name: Whipped Cream for Cornucopia Artisan Machines
Author: wrefn
Description:
Whipped Cream yay

Please let me know if there are any issues or suggestions.
[u]
Details:[/u]

New items!
[list=1]
[*][b]Heavy Whipping Cream [/b]- Recipe gotten at level 3 farming. Takes 1 milk and 1 butter.
[*][b]Vegan Heavy Whipping Cream[/b] - Recipe gotten at level 3 farming. 1 coconut oil & 1 nut milk. 
[*][b]Whipped Cream [/b]& [b]Vegan Whipped Cream [/b]- Put your heavy cream into the butter churn. It takes 2 hours to process.
[*][b]Infused Whipped Creams[/b] can be made by putting spices, jam, fruits, flowers, and more into the butter churn. You [b]must[/b] have either heavy cream or heavy whipping cream in your inventory. (Jelly-infused whipped creams are counted as their own items in the shipping log but can be disabled.)
[/list]
The 3 items if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia More Crops [/url]installed. (Just the essential pack)
[list=1]
[*][b]Cocoa Powder[/b] - Put a cocoa pod into a compact mill.
[*][b]Chocolate Whipped Cream[/b] & [b]Vegan Chocolate Whipped Cream [/b]similar to the infused whipped cream, just put the powder into the churn with any type of heavy cream as the fuel.
[/list]
This should be compatible with most things. Gift tastes are to be added.

Downloads.Description: Use a configured keystroke (Default: Q) to toggle between Wildflour's Atelier Goods and this mod's cream items. Requires WAG + Toggle Items Framework

Manifest.Name: WAG/Whipped Cream Toggle
Manifest.Description: Toggle between heavy cream & WAG's cream item.
